projects.name: on the Cloud (FOTC) – Global finance data transformation initiative.
details: Key Responsibilities:
• Supported large-scale financial data transformation programs across enterprise
finance systems.
• Worked within Agile, cross-functional teams to design and deliver governed,
high-quality data solutions.
• Led business, functional, and non-functional requirement elicitation with
finance stakeholders.
• Translated business requirements into conceptual, logical, and physical data
models aligned with governance standards.
• Designed reconciliation-ready data structures to support financial reporting and
controls.
• Performed metadata analysis, including entity definitions, attribute naming, data
types, lengths, and lineage.
• Produced and owned data modeling artifacts, mapping documents, and
analysis deliverables for development teams.
• Acted as a bridge between Business, Finance, and IT, ensuring requirement
clarity throughout the SDLC.
• Supported end-to-end data journey mapping, from source systems through transformation to consumption layers.
• Used SQL and BigQuery extensively for data analysis, validation, and
reconciliation checks.
• Ensured traceability and consistency of data and metadata across
environments.
